set_aside.subject: _authorize_photo_reference
set_aside.text: - _authorize_photo_reference: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the photo only through get_progress_photo of the progress_photos repository of that transaction with photo_id, and close that read transaction by exactly one rollback of that transaction immediately after the read, marking it closed before it evaluates project scope or client visibility and before it raises PhotoValidationError; leaving the transaction open on any path, committing it, and using a legacy transaction-level photo method are forbidden.
set_aside.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def __init__(self, connection: object) -> None
# PortalTransaction
def audit(self) -> AuditRepository
# PortalTransaction
def commit(self) -> None
# PortalTransaction
def progress_photos(self) -> ProgressPhotoRepository
# PortalTransaction
def project_sections(self) -> ProjectSectionRepository
# PortalTransaction
def rollback(self) -> None
set_aside.question: Must the removed legacy transaction-level photo operation be restored to the PortalTransaction contract, or must the note stop referring to an operation that PortalTransaction does not have?
set_aside.set_aside_because: an unchanged passage of a unit reviewed for its change

set_aside.subject: list_progress_photos
set_aside.text: - list_progress_photos: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read only through list_project_photos of the progress_photos repository of that transaction with the project_id of the context, and close that read transaction by exactly one rollback of that transaction immediately after the read, marking it closed before it filters viewer visibility or orders the result; visibility filtering and ordering belong to this function, not to persistence, and it MUST NOT use a legacy transaction-level photo method.

set_aside.subject: publish_progress_photo
set_aside.text: - publish_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] Once the project_id of the publication equals the project_id of the context, MUST open exactly one transaction by beginning it with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction, read the replay candidate only through get_progress_photo_by_intake_id of the progress_photos repository of that transaction with the intake_id of the publication, resolve a supplied section only through get_project_section of the project_sections repository of that transaction with the project_id of the context inside that same transaction, insert only through insert_progress_photo of the progress_photos repository of that transaction, append the audit only with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, and on success commit exactly once (a replay or a validation failure closes it by rollback instead); it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method. These are ProgressPhotoRepository and ProjectSectionRepository operations; the same-named legacy PortalTransaction methods are never called.
